bulas.titulo: NPLATE (ROMIPLOSTIM) INJECTION, POWDER, LYOPHILIZED, FOR SOLUTION [AMGEN, INC]

interacoes.en: Nplate may be used with other medical ITP therapies, such as corticosteroids, danazol, azathioprine, intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG), and anti-D immunoglobulin [see Clinical Studies ( 14.1 )] .
interacoes.pt: Nplate pode ser usado com outras terapias médicas de PTI, como corticosteróides, danazol, azatioprina, imunoglobulina intravenosa (IVIG) e imunoglobulina anti-D [ver Estudos Clínicos (14.1)].
